items.exampleEn: We need a strategic plan to win more customers.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要一個策略上的計畫來贏得更多顧客。

items.exampleEn: The shop closed early because of a shortage of staff.
items.exampleZh: 這家店因為人手不足提早打烊。

items.exampleEn: The development of the new phone took two years.
items.exampleZh: 新手機的開發花了兩年。

items.exampleEn: The city has seen fast growth in the last ten years.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市在過去十年快速成長。

items.exampleEn: The company had a big loss last year.
One benefit of living here is the clean air.
items.exampleZh: 住在這裡的一個好處是空氣乾淨。

items.exampleEn: His bad mood affected the whole team.
items.exampleZh: 他的壞心情影響了整個團隊。

items.sentenceEn: There is a shortage of parking spaces downtown.

items.audioEn: Our sales went up this year, but higher costs caused a small loss.
items.audioZh: 我們今年銷售額上升，但成本更高，造成了小小的虧損。
items.questionZh: 這家公司今年的結果如何？

items.sentenceEn: Time is our most important resource.
items.sentenceZh: 時間是我們最重要的資源。

items.sentenceEn: The development of the town has brought many new shops.
items.sentenceZh: 小鎮的發展帶來了很多新商店。

items.stemEn: Free lunch is one ____ of working at this company.
items.stemZh: 免費午餐是在這家公司上班的好處之一。

items.stemEn: The noise from the street ____ my sleep every night.
items.stemZh: 街上的噪音每天晚上都影響我的睡眠。

items.passageEn: Our small town is in a strategic place between two big cities. In the past, it suffered from a shortage of jobs, and many young people left. This loss affected the whole town. Ten years ago, the town began a development plan. It used its natural resources, such as hot springs and mountains, to attract visitors. The growth has been fast, and the benefits are clear: new shops, new jobs, and young families moving back.
items.passageZh: 我們的小鎮位在兩個大城市之間的重要位置。過去，小鎮苦於工作機會不足，很多年輕人都離開了。人口流失影響了整個小鎮。十年前，小鎮開始了一項發展計畫，利用溫泉和山等自然資源來吸引遊客。小鎮成長得很快，好處也很明顯：新商店、新工作，還有年輕家庭搬回來。

questions.questionZh: 過去這個小鎮有什麼問題？

options: 一年一度的大型音樂節

items.promptZh: 天氣會影響我們的計畫。
referenceEn: The weather will affect our plans.
The weather may affect our plan.
rubricZh: affect 是動詞「影響」，後面直接接受詞，不加 on
說的是可能發生的事，可用 will、may、can 等
注意不要寫成名詞 effect

items.instructionZh: 用 benefit 造一個句子，說說你的工作、學校或住處的一個好處。
referenceEn: One benefit of my job is that I can work from home.
The biggest benefit of my school is the large library.
rubricZh: benefit 在這裡是名詞「好處」，可用 One benefit of… is… 等說法
說的是自己的情況（例如 my job、my school）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
